The source says Sam can run a matched-ticket follow-up; it does not establish a prepared randomized design or guarantee conclusive causal results.
Handling time improved from 15 to 12 minutes

against a required 94% baseline and 92% threshold.

content: Cannot deploy safely or legally next quarter.

Pending approval does not establish that authorization cannot arrive next quarter. Other unsupported assertions include no regulatory risk for knowledge search, an already approved pilot, and unavoidable wasted budget for the alternative.
style: Strategic Imperative & Constraints
Inflated strategic-imperative framing adds no information to the concrete budget and capacity constraints.
*   **Hard Reality:** The team can execute only one AI pilot next quarter.
Nearly every bullet has a bold mini-heading, including routine facts. This repeated formatting and emphatic labeling make a simple four-slide decision harder to scan.

content: COO selects one AI pilot for next quarter.
Lists the options and asks for selection, but never recommends the knowledge-search pilot.
Approved source documents do not establish complete launch readiness. The credit option also invents a customer-financial-records source and places approval status in an owner field.
style: *   Owner: Pending legal approval.
An approval status is not an owner. The rigid option template forces every slide into the same four fields, producing a label that adds no decision value.

content: leaving operations ownership undefined for the current state.

style: **Readiness Explanation:** Operational handoff is blocked. The service is not ready for delivery to operations because the mandatory acceptance gate has not been cleared.
Repeats the immediately preceding blocked-handoff explanation, then repeats it again under Actions Required; similar recap padding recurs on slide 2.
